product_one_liner.value: Orange Logic provides enterprise digital- and media-asset management and content orchestration software that helps brands, archives, government agencies, and other large organizations manage and govern content at scale.
product_one_liner.notes: One-sentence summary of the company’s description of its platform and target users.

pricing_page.notes: The site navigation promotes booking a demo and contains no pricing link; the demo page is a contact/demo destination, and no public pricing page was found.

named_customers.notes: Both are named in the company’s customer/logo wall.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile reports 278 employees, which falls within this band.

hq_location.notes: The company profile identifies Irvine, California, United States as its location.

founded_year.notes: The company homepage states it was founded in 1998.

eng_blog.notes: The blog is a general DAM/industry insights blog; two architecture-themed pieces identify Helen Shacklett as Head of Content, not an engineer, and the evidence does not establish an engineering-authored blog.

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal and documentation index provide numerous API, integration, authentication, and SDK articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current openings list includes Applied AI Product Engineer.

model_provider.value: NVIDIA Nemotron open models (Agent Studio); Orange Logic also describes Agent Studio as model-flexible.
model_provider.notes: Orange Logic announced Nemotron models in Agent Studio, while its AI FAQ says organizations may also use supported managed models or bring their own.

compliance_certs.notes: Listed on Orange Logic’s security and compliance page.

last_funding.notes: The latest round is reported as private equity on May 16, 2023; its amount is undisclosed. Because the schema requires a numeric amount, 0 is a neutral placeholder and does not mean the round was free.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified funding was the May 2023 private-equity investment, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The company has a live Sales Development Representative posting with an apply link.

launched_6mo.notes: Orange Logic announced Orange Builder on September 30, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small leadership roster has no reported C-level/VP appointment in the period; the identified October 2026 Head of Product is listed at Director seniority, and the company news page’s listed Managing Director appointment is dated June 2025.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The SDR job posting names HubSpot as a preferred CRM and 6sense and LinkedIn Sales Navigator as preferred ABM/sales tools.
